'''Ordez''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Karrid]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielded]] a massive [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] that produced identical beams of [[Color/Legends|red-black]] energy.

==Biography==
Ordez and fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quux]] were assigned to the [[Ascendant Spear]] in the year [[3640 BBY]] to serve the newly appointed member of the [[Dark Council]], [[Darth Karrid]].

When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] broke free from his restraints with the help of [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] Operative [[Theron Shan]], he went to confront his former pupil, [[Darth Karrid]] in the chambers in which she could control the [[Ascendant Spear|Spear]].

When [[Gnost-Dural]] arrived, he was met with [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] Ordez, [[Quux|Lord Quux]] and [[Unidentified Human male Sith apprentice|Karrid's Human Male Apprentice]], all of which were meditating in order to support [[Darth Karrid|Karrid]] in controlling the Ascendant Spear. When they saw [[Gnost-Dural|Dural]] enter, the trio stopped their meditation and engaged the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in a duel. Ordez and [[Quux]] together were powerful enough to hold off [[Gnost-Dural]], the only problem being that they were not coordinated, constantly interrupting each others attacks, this allowed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to kill [[Unidentified Human male Sith apprentice|Karrid's Apprentice]] and focus on the other two.

When [[Darth Karrid|Karrid]] lost control of the [[Ascendant Spear|Spear]] and the crew began to evacuate, [[Gnost-Dural]] tried to convince the Sith Lords to escape the Spear, Quux lifted his weapons to kill [[Gnost-Dural|Dural]] but Ordez, guided by self-preservation, deactivated his [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]] and ran to the [[escape pod]]s, [[Quux]] took his lead and followed him.
